capabilities: Open the current note as a Markmap via a toolbar tree icon or the Open as Markmap command
Update the preview live while editing and on saved external file changes
Pan, zoom, and fold or unfold nodes in the map
Zoom in, zoom out, fit view, expand all, and collapse all from the preview toolbar
Show a hint for empty notes and render errors in the preview status bar
extras: Desktop-only per manifest.json; requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; notes are not modified by the preview.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view a note's heading and list structure as an interactive, zoomable mind map.
summary: Renders the current Markdown note as an interactive Markmap mind map in a separate pane, updating live as you edit.
